title: Actual reconstruction components on raw rationalized Hom groups
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and finite coefficient fields inside a fixed $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, with valuation rings, uniformizers and finite quotients as in [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. For a field $F$ write $R_F=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,s}=\lim_n B_{F,n}$ and $B_{F,n}=(\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^n)_s$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived categories of module sheaves on the small pro-etale site of $s$, with the coefficient universes of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Put $H_F=\mathcal L_s^F\mathcal R_s^F$, with actual unit $u^F$ of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], normalized by [lem-trf-completion-unit-strict-quotient-model]. On the full derived-complete subcategory [def-weil-derived-complete] write $v^F=(u^F)^{-1}$, using [lem-pur-normalized-reconstruction-adjunction-calculus].

For each $E$ let $\mathcal C_E=D^b_c(s,\mathcal O_E)$ be the full constructible category with uniformly bounded reductions [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and let $\mathcal C_E[1/\varpi_E]=D^b_c(s,E)$ be its raw rationalization, with unchanged objects and Hom groups tensored with $E$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Let $Q_E$ denote its localization functor. For $E\subset L$ use the completed scalar functor $S^{\mathrm{int}}_{L/E}=\widehat T$ of [lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-well-defined] and its rationalization $S_{L/E}$. Use the specified integral comparisons $\beta_{L/E}$ of [lem-pod-completion-unit-scalar-intertwining].

The quotient-system realization of $H_E$ is $\mathcal O_E$-linear, and it restricts to an endofunctor of $\mathcal C_E$. Its raw rationalization is the $E$-linear endofunctor $H_E^{\mathrm{rat}}$ with
$$ H_E^{\mathrm{rat}}(C)=H_EC,\qquad H_E^{\mathrm{rat}}\Bigl(\sum_i f_i\otimes a_i\Bigr)=\sum_i H_E(f_i)\otimes a_i. $$
It agrees, under the strict identity-tower identification, with rational identity compact support defined in [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], using [lem-weil-compact-support-reduction-tower-functor] for that tower. The components $v_{E,C}=Q_E(v^E_C)$ and $u_{E,C}=Q_E(u^E_C)$ are inverse natural transformations between $H_E^{\mathrm{rat}}$ and the identity. Explicitly, for every $h=\sum_i f_i\otimes a_i:C\to D$,
$$ v_{E,D}H_E^{\mathrm{rat}}(h)=h v_{E,C},\qquad H_E^{\mathrm{rat}}(h)u_{E,C}=u_{E,D}h. $$
The images $\beta^{\mathrm{rat}}_{L/E,C}=Q_L(\beta_{L/E,C})$ are natural isomorphisms
$$ S_{L/E}H_E^{\mathrm{rat}}\xrightarrow{\sim}H_L^{\mathrm{rat}}S_{L/E},\qquad v_{L,S_{L/E}C}\beta^{\mathrm{rat}}_{L/E,C}=S_{L/E}(v_{E,C}). $$
These assertions include all rational morphisms and do not require choosing integral lifts of rational isomorphisms or adjoining idempotent summands.

external.place: Definitions 3.5.2-3.5.3, Lemma 3.5.7 and Lemma 6.8.2(1). Agent-formulated comparison and descent calculation extracted from the returned proof, not a verbatim theorem of this source.

proof.text: Give module sheaves and strict systems the constant-section linear actions already used in the compact-support tower proof. Restriction to the completed-ring tower and ordinary limit are linear. Right-derived limit is linear by its K-injective comparison; the actual reduction is then linear by adjoint linearity. Thus their composite is linear. The normalizedDerivedLinear comparison identifies the derived constant-section action with the published integral action on source and target.

source.place: First sentence, identity compact support: agent expansion of reconstruction linearity and raw rational descent; Bhatt-Scholze Definitions 3.5.2-3.5.3 and Lemma 3.5.7 supply reconstruction background, not this descent calculation.

proof.text: The intrinsic/legacy completeness equivalence, using a universe-zero prime-field datum of the given characteristic, puts every integral constructible object in the complete subcategory used by normalized reconstruction. Its actual adjunction unit is invertible. Closure under isomorphisms preserves constructibility and the same uniform reduction interval. Lift the actual completion into the full subcategory and restrict the actual unit. The restriction is linear because it is naturally isomorphic to the identity.

source.place: First sentence, identity compact support: agent expansion of reconstruction linearity and raw rational descent; Bhatt-Scholze Definitions 3.5.2-3.5.3 and Lemma 3.5.7 supply reconstruction background, not this descent calculation.

proof.text: Apply lem-pod-identity-reduction-tower to the actual reduction calculus and the coefficient-prime unit in k. Apply lem-pod-compact-support-normalized-tower-limit to this exact chosen tower and its evaluations. IntegralRealization gives equality of the two ambient functors, hence the identity-component comparison eta. Compose eta, total limit of theta, and inverse rho, and lift through the fully faithful constructible inclusion to obtain kappa; cancellation gives its normalization equation. Tensor the natural isomorphism unit followed by kappa. Compose with the inverse actual rational unit. Its component is Q(kappa), by the inverse-unit component formula and cancellation. This proves the strict identity-support clause without replacing its tower or its Roos projections.

proof.text: Use the existing ScalarLocalization.map construction on the restricted linear endofunctor. It has the same objects and its maps are baseChange of the integral linear Hom maps. The tensor pure-element formula gives the specified action, and its existing additive and localized-linear instances apply.

proof.text: Apply the canonical localization functor to the actual unit isomorphism at every unchanged object. Naturality on a pure tensor follows from integral naturality and the tensor-composition formula. Tensor induction proves naturality on zero and sums. NatIso.ofComponents supplies its inverse, whose naturality gives the displayed inverse equation for every rational morphism.

source.place: First sentence, identity compact support: agent expansion of reconstruction linearity and raw rational descent; Bhatt-Scholze Definitions 3.5.2-3.5.3 and Lemma 3.5.7 supply reconstruction background, not this descent calculation.

proof.text: Define the integral scalar comparison as S(unit inverse) followed by the target unit, naturally in the source. Its composite with the inverse target unit is S(unit inverse) by cancellation. This equation characterizes the comparison uniquely, and hence agrees with the specified integral comparison wherever that comparison is realized. Define the rational comparison in the same manner from the rational units. The prescribed object equalities and component HEq equations, together with S_rat(Q_E(f)) = Q_L(S_int(f)) from the existing scalar-extension specification at 1 tensor f, identify its entire component with Q_L of the integral comparison. Cancellation of the rational target unit proves the final equation. No integral isomorphism lift or idempotent completion is used.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-N0-15b2518d3 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item in full: statement, 6 steps and the full statements of all 23 cited nodes, plus def-weil-integral-scalar-extension and the parent normalization lemma (step 5 of the parent cites this item for old step 8). There is no repair note, so this is not a re-split. There are no new nodes. proof_deps equals the union of the step uses, all cited ids exist and none is merged, and the cited closure does not contain the item, so there is no cycle. Step 1: the scalar-extension theorem allows L=E with the same uniformizer, which makes iota_m the identity. Its tower is U_s R_s P from the evaluation calculus. The strict Roos comparison (products exact) identifies the theorem's functor with H_E, and clause (3) plus bilinear composition gives O_E-linearity. Step 2: the reconstruction calculus applies (l invertible on s), and the unit is an iso on complete objects. D^b_c(s,O_E) membership is iso-invariant, which the step argues in a few lines inline. Step 3: for the identity compactification, j_! and R id_* are canonically the identity, and the restriction-of-scalars comparison is the identity by its stated construction. H_E C is therefore a derived limit of the system in def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support, which is the same reasoning as the parent's PASSed step 2. Steps 4-5: semilinear scalar localization with phi=id and t=u=varpi_E. Its fraction formula matches the item's tensor formula, and the inverse and naturality equations need only the balanced tensor relations, so they hold for torsion Hom groups. Step 6: phi from O_E into O_L with varpi_E invertible in L (ramified case included). T-hat lands in D^b_c(s,O_L) by the constructible lemma, which concerns the same functor. The beta equation from completion-unit-scalar-intertwining is carried over by Q_L together with the morphism formula of def-weil-rationalization-karoubi. Sources: the blueprint main-20261015 lem-pod-point-dualizing-complex proof, first sentence; Bhatt-Scholze Def. 3.5.2/3.5.3 and Lem. 3.5.7 on printed pp. 24-25, used as background only (proof_origin is agent, correctly). No SGA. I accept all declared tool uses, including the trf unit model, which the parent review already accepted as a generic tool. Duplicate search: lem-sf-identification-coefficient-transport states a different claim (alpha = vRa_!), so there is no duplicate. Small cases checked: C=0, a torsion C with Hom tensor E = 0, L=E, ramified L, and empty sums. No changes.
